_about: Real-world facts the engine needs. Claude updates this when a plan, target, phase or gate changes, and cites the source in 'evidence'.
procedure: Left isolated ACL reconstruction, patellar-tendon autograft

nutrition_targets.source: nutrition_guide.md; shake dropped as a target 10/8

nutrition_reference._about: Daily reference values for the weekly recap, from nutrition_guide.md 'Micronutrient Reference' (added 2026-10-08): standard adult-male DRI / FDA DV. Not targets; judged week to week at the checkpoint. min = at least, max = at most; show = how the recap prints it.

weight_rule._about: nutrition_guide.md 'Calories': after 2 consistent weeks, still losing/flat -> add 150-250 kcal/day; gaining ~0.25-0.75 lb/week -> stay; consistently >1 lb/week after the initial rebound -> reduce ~150-200 kcal. A consistent week = at least min_readings morning weigh-ins. Golden rule 3: a falling weekly average is always flagged.

weekly_template._about: Planned sessions per day, used to score the week and to answer 'what's today'. Codes: knee (the next of Session A/B; they alternate A -> B -> A regardless of day), pt, upperA, upperB, accessory, power, cond. The Tue knee session may run Wed. Upper this week (10/4) ran its own placement: Fri 10/9 A, Sat 10/10 B. Weeks before a revision use weekly_template_history (each entry applies through its 'until' date).
weekly_template.source: ACL_Dashboard_Working_Rules.md 'Program structure' and ACL_Whole_Athlete_AddOn.md section 3, revised 10/9; power & mobility (Sat) from 10/17 at the earliest

weekly_template_history.source: the template before the 10/9 revision: Whole_Athlete_AddOn.md section 3 and ACL_Recovery_State_2026-10-04.md section 6

daily_minimum._about: Weighted heel-prop rounds that make a full daily minimum (the floor) from a date on; fewer rounds score half. Log each round as floor_am / floor_pm = Y (floor_am for a single round, any time of day).

rounds.source: AM + PM rounds, as the floor was scored before 10/9
ACL_Dashboard_Working_Rules.md, revised 10/9 (Nick 10/9): morning check + one 10-min weighted heel prop a day

rehab.next_gate: Phase 3 exit -> Phase 4: full/symmetric ROM, normal gait, minimal/no post-exercise effusion, quad LSI >= 70%, good single-leg control. Earliest by calendar Tue 2026-10-20.

knots.name: Straightening
knots.evidence: Phase 1 exit criteria met (extension 0, SLR without lag) before Phase 2 work; exact date approximate

knot_gates.3: Before Phase 4 checklist (master plan): full/symmetric ROM, normal gait, minimal/no effusion, quad LSI ~>=70%, good single-leg control; PT agrees
knot_gates.4: Before Running checklist: full extension, >=95% flexion, no/trace effusion, quad LSI >80%, good SL squat, pain-free pogos, good landings, rehab team agrees
knot_gates.5: Before Higher Plyometrics/Agility: running tolerated, quad ~>=85%, hop ~>=85%, no meaningful effusion, good landing and SL force absorption
knot_gates.6: Before Hard Cutting/Pivoting: quad >=90%, hop >=90%, effusion <= trace, full ROM, running and sprint progressions complete, good high-speed decel, no apprehension
knot_gates.7: Before Full Return to Sport: full battery ~>=95%, KOOS/IKDC/ACL-RSI, full practice tolerated, surgeon/PT clearance

measurement_metrics._about: Metrics allowed in real/logs/measurements.csv (one row per side per measurement). lsi: 'higher' = L/R x 100 on the same date and method (higher is better); 'lower' = R/L x 100 (timed tests). label: the short name in views; now: shown in real/NOW.md's latest-measured line. Add a metric here before logging it.

ext_deg.label: extension
ext_deg.about: knee extension; 0 = straight, + = hyperextension, - = short of straight

sl_leg_press_plates.label: SL leg press
sl_leg_press_plates.about: single-leg leg press max; a stand-in for quad LSI until a dynamometer test

milestones._about: Real firsts worth a story moment. Record date + evidence. first_kneel triggers the finale's final image (see saga/bible/_gm/arc.md).
